title: Career Roadmap: Software Developer
summary: A Software Developer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and maintains software applications that solve user and business problems. Software Developers work on websites, mobile applications, enterprise systems, cloud platforms, databases, and software products.

facts.Current degree: BS (4-Year Bachelor of Science - IIT / IISc / Online & Research-oriented)

blocks.text: A Software Developer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and maintains software applications that solve user and business problems. Software Developers work on websites, mobile applications, enterprise systems, cloud platforms, databases, and software products.

A degree in Computer Science & Data Analysis can provide a foundation in programming, algorithms, databases, data handling, and computational problem-solving. To become job-ready, students should also develop software engineering skills and build practical applications.

blocks.label: Qualification note
blocks.text: Confirm the exact degree title, curriculum, accreditation or recognition, eligibility, and admission requirements with the institution offering the BS. Employers may have different degree requirements, and practical skills remain important alongside formal education.

sections.heading: What does a Software Developer do?

items.text: Analyse requirements and convert them into software features.
Write readable, maintainable, and efficient code.
Design application components and integrate APIs.
Develop user interfaces and backend services.
Store, retrieve, and manage application data.
Test software and fix bugs.
Use version control and collaborate through code reviews.
Deploy applications and troubleshoot production issues.
Improve application security, performance, and reliability.
Maintain technical documentation and support future enhancements.

blocks.text: Frontend Developer
Builds the user-facing parts of websites and web applications.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, responsive design, accessibility
Backend Developer
Develops APIs, business logic, authentication, databases, and server-side services.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: Java and Spring Boot, Python, SQL, REST APIs, security fundamentals
Full-Stack Developer
Builds both frontend and backend components, integrating interfaces, APIs, databases, and deployment.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: React, Java/Spring Boot or another backend framework, SQL, Git, deployment
Mobile Application Developer
Develops applications for Android, iOS, or cross-platform mobile environments.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, or React Native; APIs and mobile testing
Cloud and Platform Software Developer
Builds cloud-hosted services, deployment pipelines, and scalable software infrastructure.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, CI/CD, monitoring, distributed systems
Data-Oriented Software Developer
Creates data processing applications, reporting systems, integrations, and data-driven services.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: Python, SQL, data structures, APIs, data pipelines, analytics
Core subjects to master

rows.text: Variables, functions, OOP, exceptions, file handling
Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash tables
Operating systems, memory, processes, computer architecture
APIs, authentication, business logic, database integration
Secure coding, input validation, access control, secrets management

blocks.text: Year-by-year learning plan
Stage 1
Programming and computer science foundations

items.text: Choose one primary programming language, such as Java or Python.
Learn variables, loops, functions, OOP, and error handling.
Practise data structures and algorithms.
Learn Git and GitHub.
Build small command-line applications.

blocks.text: Stage 2
Databases and application development

items.text: Learn SQL and relational database design.
Study HTTP, APIs, and client-server architecture.
Build web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Learn a frontend framework such as React.
Create an application that connects a user interface to a database-backed service.

blocks.text: Stage 3
Backend engineering and testing

items.text: Learn a backend framework such as Spring Boot or FastAPI.
Develop REST APIs and implement authentication.
Practise unit testing, integration testing, and debugging.
Learn database transactions and basic performance optimisation.
Build a complete full-stack application.

blocks.text: Stage 4
Deployment and job preparation

items.text: Deploy an application to a suitable cloud platform.
Learn Docker and CI/CD fundamentals.
Improve security, logging, and error handling.
Complete an internship or substantial team project.
Practise coding interviews, SQL questions, and software design fundamentals.

blocks.text: Adapt the stages to the official degree duration and curriculum. Students should begin internships and applications when they can demonstrate practical skills rather than waiting until every technology is mastered.

rows.text: JavaScript, SQL; C++ if relevant to target roles
Java with Spring Boot, Python with FastAPI/Django, or Node.js
Issue tracking, code reviews, technical documentation

blocks.label: Practical strategy
blocks.text: Learn one stack deeply before adding more. For example, Java + Spring Boot + React + PostgreSQL is a coherent route for full-stack development. Python can be added for automation, data analysis, and AI-related applications.

blocks.label: Project 1
blocks.text: Task and project management application
Build a system with user accounts, tasks, priorities, deadlines, and progress tracking.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: CRUD operations, authentication, database design, frontend development

blocks.label: Project 2
blocks.text: E-commerce application
Implement product listings, search, a shopping cart, order management, and a simulated checkout workflow.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: APIs, relational data modelling, validation, security, testing

blocks.label: Project 3
blocks.text: Data analytics dashboard
Build a dashboard that imports or retrieves data, processes it, and presents useful metrics and visualisations.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: Python, SQL, APIs, data analysis, visualisation

blocks.label: Project 4
blocks.text: Production-style REST API
Create a backend service with authentication, validation, structured error responses, tests, logs, and deployment.

blocks.label: Skills
blocks.text: backend engineering, API design, testing, deployment, maintainability

For each project, document the problem, architecture, setup instructions, technology choices, database schema, test results, security considerations, and known limitations. Make sure you can explain the code rather than merely copying a tutorial.

By graduation, a competitive candidate should aim to have:

items.text: A solid foundation in programming, algorithms, and databases.
Two or three complete, well-documented projects.
Experience developing APIs and integrating databases.
Basic understanding of testing, security, and deployment.
A GitHub portfolio that demonstrates independent work.
Practical experience through an internship, team project, or open-source contribution.
The ability to explain design choices and solve coding problems during interviews.

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: The BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis can provide a foundation for a Software Developer career. To improve employability, combine the academic programme with strong programming fundamentals, one focused technology stack, practical projects, software testing, and deployment experience.
